blocks.text: By default, configuration warnings appear for application segments to notify you of an error or existing issue. If you do not want to receive configuration warnings for application segments, you can disable them. You can always enable the warnings again.
If you disable configuration warnings, you will not receive messaging about an error or issue for application segments.

For example, if you have an existing wildcard application segment .example.com and you add an application segment that is more specified www.example.com, then you would receive the following warning if warnings are enabled.
To change your configuration warning settings:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Private Access > Private Applications > Defined Application Segments.
Click the Column Menu icon (), and select Set Application Warnings.
The Set Application Segment Configuration Warnings window appears.
Select Enabled to allow configuration warnings to appear. Select Disabled to stop receiving configuration warnings. The setting is enabled by default.
